settings.text:
Unfortunately, fake websites exist that pose as wornbywater.com to sell jewellery fraudulently. I do my best to get these sites closed.

There are several things you can look out for to avoid fraud:

If the prices are strange — for example, $47.83. If the price is significantly lower than what you find on wornbywater.com. If the URL of the website contains a name you do not recognise. If spelling or grammar errors appear, or a use of language that raises suspicion. If a foreign currency is used even though the site claims to be from Australia.

The only official Australian website is wornbywater.com.

If you have doubts about whether a website is authentic, do not hesitate to contact me — Narelle
